other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Transformers (like TF-IDF, SVD, frequency encoders, and imputers) are fitted on the full training dataset prior to the cross-validation split. This leaks validation fold statistics into the training folds, yielding overly optimistic CV scores and potentially suboptimal hyperparameters or early stopping.

summary: The agent delivers a strong and comprehensive solution featuring deep learning, gradient boosting, and robust feature engineering. However, it relies on a hardcoded, naive ensemble blend rather than optimising weights. Additionally, while the agent correctly prevents test data leakage, it suffers from cross-validation leakage by fitting text transformers and imputers on the full training dataset prior to splitting into CV folds.
